payload.gloss: an entity with more than one head whose payloads differ, produced when concurrent sessions on different branches wrote to the same head differently (two versions, or a version and a retraction) and the branches merged. Heads that carry the same payload have converged and read as one. Divergence is state, not error: it is reported, never silently resolved.
